question.text: Under the Stewardship Code, a Cat III Activist AIF must have a clear POLICY for:

answer.text: Collaboration with other institutional investors to preserve investor interest.
Intra-day trading in the same investee companies.
Offering discounts on Pre-IPO shares to retail.

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 10.1.4.1: Stewardship Code mandates a clear policy for collaboration with other institutional investors, as well as active monitoring and voting on important matters. The Trap: Others are unrelated to stewardship. Cross-Exam Context: III-A/C (Compliance) tests same. XIX-C same.
